english.title: Cause an unlicensed person carry on a section 17(2) of the Energy Act 2008 activity at a controlled place
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 22(2) and (3) of the Energy Act 2008.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 14(1) of the Energy Act 2008 provides that proceedings for a relevant offence may be taken, and the offence may for all incidental purposes be treated as having been committed, in any place in the United Kingdom.
(ii) section 14(3) of the Energy Act 2008 provides that proceedings for a relevant offence alleged to have been committed in a controlled place may not be instituted in England and Wales except by the Secretary of State or a person authorised by the Secretary of State, or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding £50,000.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.
Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
